title: The Field of Flowers
text: White flowers to the horizon, under a sky that is for once only a sky. No birds sing. No wind moves the petals. The air is sweet, the ground soft. Nothing here is wrong at all, which is the most troubling thing you have seen in days.

options.label: Lie down among the flowers and rest. Surely you have earned a moment of peace.

outcomes.text: You sleep among the flowers and wake whole, every wound closed and every mind clear. Nothing came for you in the night.

options.label: Don't trust it. Keep walking with your eyes down, and do not breathe too deeply.

outcomes.text: You cross the field quickly. Some of you regret not staying; for weeks they dream of white petals.
